environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with priority 1, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet with priority 2, (3) A custom rule with priority 3 that applies a rate limit of 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP with action BLOCK. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task definition specifies a read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true) and the container runs as a non-root user (user: '1000:1000'). The ALB access logs are shipped to CloudWatch with a metric filter alarm on 4xx spike. Note: the AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet includes SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING (blocks query strings > 2048 bytes) and CrossSiteScripting_QUERYSTRING but does NOT include SQL injection rules — those are in the separate AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet which is NOT attached to this WebACL.

config.monitoring: CloudWatch metric filter on ALB 4xx responses
